rv.q: But 'The Full Monty,' if you see it done right as is the case here, strips away more than you might think.
It is simply a joy in every way; if you love musicals, you should see it.
A trip to the Paramount Theatre is, as always, well worth the visit.
Add in a terrific cast and you've got a winner from top to bottom!

Fun, cheeky (pun intended) and R-rated, the musical by writer Terrence McNally and composer/lyricist David Yazbek is based on the 1997. British comedy about a ragtag group of unemployed steelworkers who form a male striptease troupe.
Under the skilled leadership and direction of Jim Corti who has put together a wonderful cast of players, you get to see 'The Full Monty' as never before!
With superb direction, stellar performances, and a production that radiates joy and sincerity, The Full Monty is the definition of a feel-good musical.
